The '''''Crinya''-class freighter''' was a [[Light freighter/Legends|light freighter]] used during the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==Characteristics==
The ''Crinya''-class freighter was produced by [[Gallofree Yards, Inc./Legends|Gallofree Yards, Inc.]] until sometime between [[10 BBY/Legends|10]] to [[6 BBY/Legends|6 BBY]].<ref name="CCTime">The Trax sector campaign can take place between 0 ABY and 4 ABY and the ''[[Planet Jumper]]'' is described as being a "decade old"</ref> At 29.2 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] in length, it could handle around 90 metric tons of cargo and required at least a crew of two to operate efficiently - though a single individual could make do in an emergency.<ref name="Showdown-CC" />

==History==
One such ''Crinya''-class freighter was used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. The modified ''[[Planet Jumper]]'' was assigned to the [[Trax sector/Legends|Trax sector]] and fought during the [[Battle of Bissillirus]]. It was used to help steal stored food supplies and an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Convoy/Legends|convoy]].<ref name="Showdown-CC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Crinya''-class freighter first appeared as a picture in the [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars Gamemaster Kit]]''. It was seen in the last chapter of the Trax sector campaign, which described the Battle of Bissillirus. It was not until the campaign was republished in the ''[[Classic Campaigns]]'' supplement, that the ship was identified. ''Classic Campigns'' greatly expanded the last chapter and added several details to the battle, as well as the ''Crinya''-class freighter, ''Planet Jumper''.
